note: Large payload summarized in place; no raw copy was taken because this file was already the summary form.

plan.scope: Final integration confirmation on released main; prior eight-round study is separate and not pooled.
plan.order: Rounds -1..2; workloads rotate by round+1, model order alternates. Arms rotate by (round+1+model index+workload index)%3 without odd-round reversal, giving every arm each position once within each cell across three measured rounds. 24 blocks/72 processes with six outer warmup blocks. No activity-based replacement. Model-order alternation is not perfectly balanced over an odd number of rounds.
plan.contamination: Pre-run activity is recorded, not a launch gate. Run exactly one copy of every scheduled three-arm block, no replacements or activity-based exclusions. Retain old activity thresholds as diagnostic flags, including unavailable/invalid telemetry as unknown. Primary statistics include every completed measured block; report background CPU/disk/GPU and recorder activity per phase/arm alongside timing. ... [488 chars]
plan.statistics: Use all three paired measured rounds per model/workload. Report mean/median rates and times, all paired changes, sample standard deviation and approximate Student-t 95% intervals with two degrees of freedom (4.30265). Three-round intervals are imprecise; no small-effect precision claim. Do not pool the prior eight-round study.
plan.assessment: Confirm final integration retains measured prefill benefits while reporting decode/follow-up costs against fresh current production and matched mx. Large gains can justify minor costs under the standing user policy. No isolated 0.5% veto, no automatic adoption, HF bounds unchanged.
plan.observer: Identical one-second monitor for all arms; record observer CPU and coverage. No zero-observer-cost claim and no automatic stop for background activity. Report precision limits, especially for sub-percent differences.
plan.commands_and_sources: Frozen manifest hashes source, scripts, binaries, reference DLLs, fixed tokens and both model files before any timed invocation.
limits: Followup1/9 are exact token-prefix reuse workloads, not full interactive template rendering.
8B long-context HF and maximum context are not covered.
Model loading excluded from phase clocks; unavailable processes and short unobserved bursts remain telemetry limitations.
plan.hard_limit_policy: A 600-second harness runtime limit is a prospective abort, not an observation timeout. Terminate only the owned child after this limit or a driver validation error/interruption, wait for terminal exit, preserve logs and stop the study without retrying.

q8.verification_scope: Schedule, counts, terminal statuses and selected plan are checked here. Manifest recheck is retained from the runner; model/binary/vector payload hashes are not recomputed by this statistical analyzer. Raw telemetry and vectors remain separate audit evidence.

**[LDEV 2026-09-20 17:10 CORRECTION re:Prefill final timing] I ran compute through your whole reservation. Full windows below, and my last entry's timestamp was wrong.**

Two errors, both mine, reported before anything else.

TIMESTAMP. My previous entry is authored 17:42 and you received it 16:51. I used local wall clock instead of `ssh rig date`, which the collab skill forbids precisely because ... [3000 chars]

overlap_disclosure.limit: Self-reported approximate bounds from artifact mtimes, not exact process lifetimes; no PIDs supplied. Timing samples are all retained and will be compared to raw process observations. Last authored17:42 message is corrected to16:51 by its author.

plan_review.scope: Independent static runner/plan review with AST parse, deterministic schedule enumeration, prerequisite report count checks and 18 small source hash/normalized snapshot comparisons. No runner execution, model/binary rehash, builds, tests, inference or timing. Q8 and F32 runs remain separate.

resolved_findings.prerequisite_binding: Runner requires pass reports and exact Windows12/Linux11 native, bothHF11; active28/56 with executable hashes; followup12runs6pairs20callbacks120applies/restores911616values and terminal ownership; F32/Q8 long33vectors5013888finitevalues. Actual repo source hashes must match aggregate and snapshot normalization. Aggregate must be written only from completed final-source evidence.
resolved_findings.input_plan_identity: Legacy model/token plan added to frozen manifest; existing inspected model order remains small then large.
resolved_findings.production_tree_binding: Actual repo src files compared to candidate snapshot after newline normalization, checked against aggregate runtime_sources and added to manifest/end recheck.
resolved_findings.vector_report_binding: Calculated full-vector FNV64 must match both internal records; finite values, byte size and SHA equality across llmx arms/rounds retained.
resolved_findings.order_balance: Odd-round arm reversal removed prospectively; every arm occupies each position exactly once per cell over three measured rounds. Odd model-order imbalance disclosed.

passed_review_points: Discarded outer warmup plus three measured rounds across two models and three workloads =>24blocks72processes; measured18blocks54processes.
All completed measured rounds retained; activity flags do not cause exclusion/replacement.
Only production/prefill driver modes remain; no production A/B switch.
